title: Ice Age Sahara as origin of Egyptian civilization

tellings.quote: I think if we want to get into the origins of ancient Egyptian civilization, we're going to have to start looking at what the Sahara was doing during the Ice Age.

plain: The writer Graham Hancock suggests that ancient Egyptian civilization began in the Sahara during the Ice Age. He tells Michels "we're going to have to start looking at what the Sahara was doing during the Ice Age" to find those origins, and he cites no source. If he is right, Egypt's history would reach back much further than usually thought, to a people who lived in what is now desert.
